mentions.name: coldstart
mentions.description: A codebase notebook that helps AI agents work better in a codebase. It is written and maintained by the AI agent that is writing or reading the notes, keeping the codebase knowledge fresh across sessions.
mentions.problem: Coldstart: an AI agent re-learns the codebase on every new session, which the author found genuinely frustrating.
mentions.source_excerpt: i built a tool called coldstart which is a codebase notebook. It is written and maintained by the AI agent that is writing or reading the notes and keeps it fresh, always.
mentions.author: akashgoenka
